subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers retire this broad field report in favor of narrower canonical issues, or keep it open as an umbrella until every remaining slice is explicitly fixed or rejected?
rationale: The strongest remaining problems are already split to open canonical issues, but not every slice has a proven focused tracker; deciding whether the umbrella still has product-triage value is a maintainer workflow choice, not a safe automated close.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Link the config and Discord slices to their open canonical issues, file any missing focused follow-ups such as the cron docs/list mismatch if desired, then close this umbrella.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open as a broad field-report tracker while maintainers continue validating each slice across owners.

options.title: Close as partially superseded
options.body: Close now with links to existing canonical trackers and ask reporters to re-file any leftover slice with current-main proof.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Link the config and Discord slices to their open canonical issues, file any missing focused follow-ups such as the cron docs/list mismatch if desired, then close this umbrella.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-surface routing decision and their recent history appears closest across cron docs plus the broader operator cleanup context.
